quote: Whenever authorized signs are erected indicating that no right turn, left turn or U-turn is permitted, it shall be unlawful for any person operating a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter to disobey the direction of any such sign, except where such person dismounts from the bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter to make any such turn, in which event such person shall then obey the regulations applicable to pedestrians.

activation.condition: An authorized no-U-turn sign is erected for a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter operator.

obligation.description: The operator must follow the direction of the no-U-turn sign unless the exact dismount exception applies.

exceptions.source_clause: except where such person dismounts from the bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter to make any such turn, in which event such person shall then obey the regulations applicable to pedestrians.
exceptions.description: Dismount to make the turn; then obey regulations applicable to pedestrians. Authorization and those regulations need source review.

timing.description: Record sign approach, dismount, U-turn and subsequent pedestrian movement in source time order.

parameter_refs.name: dismount_before_turn
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: true or false planned controller branch; actual body contact is source-observed
